risks.title: T-Mobile Customer Concentration
risks.summary: The company is highly dependent on T-Mobile for site rental revenue following the MLA agreement and the divestiture of wireless operations.
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on T-Mobile following the Master License Agreement and the acquisition of wireless operations. Any failure by T-Mobile to meet its contractual obligations could have a significant impact on business and financial results. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Regulatory Approval Risks for Spectrum Transactions
risks.summary: Spectrum transactions with Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile are subject to regulatory approvals and may not be completed.
risks.score_rationale: Spectrum sale transactions with Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile remain subject to FCC regulatory approval and other customary closing conditions. Failure to complete these transactions could negatively impact the company's financial position. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition in the Tower Industry
risks.summary: Competition in the tower industry is robust, which could negatively impact the company's revenues and growth.
risks.score_rationale: Intense competition in the communications tower industry could limit the company's ability to increase tenancies and grow site rental revenue. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Fixed Rate Escalator Risks
risks.summary: Fixed rate escalators could negatively impact operating results, cash flows and the company's financial condition.
risks.score_rationale: Fixed rate escalators in long-term lease agreements could limit revenue growth and negatively impact operating results and cash flows. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Land Rights and Ground Lease Risks
risks.summary: The company may face difficulties renewing or maintaining land rights under current terms, which could negatively impact its business and financial results.
risks.score_rationale: Although 18% of the portfolio is located on owned land or land with perpetual easements, the majority of towers (82%) are on leased land. Over 65% of towers on leased land have lease expirations of 10 years or more, but risks related to non-renewal or cost increases could impact operations. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Climate Event Risks
risks.summary: Climate events could negatively impact the company's towers and financial results.
risks.score_rationale: Climate events and natural disasters could damage tower infrastructure and tenant equipment, impacting operations and financial results. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technological Advancement Risks
risks.summary: Technological advancements could reduce demand for tower services, negatively impacting operating results and the company's financial condition.
risks.score_rationale: Technological advancements such as satellite or alternative wireless technologies could reduce demand for traditional tower services, negatively impacting portfolio utilization and revenues. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
